_about: Multi-file sets for D6 file chat (tests/d6_files_eval.py multi <label>). All files of a set are attached together; `expect` includes the file names the answer must cite.

questions.answer: Reg_circular.pdf and normal_file.pdf; both signed by Tarek El-Kholy (طارق الخولي)

questions.answer: التثقيف المالي: test_cirular.pdf؛ غسل الأموال: Reg_circular.pdf و normal_file.pdf
